stories.title: India records $5.93 billion in real estate investments
stories.summary: Institutional investments in India’s real estate sector rose 39 percent year-on-year to $5.93 billion between January and September 2026. Domestic investors accounted for nearly 60 percent of the total capital inflows. Hospitality and alternative assets saw investments grow six to seven times compared to the previous year.

stories.title: India office markets may require 260 million square feet more space
stories.summary: India’s eight largest office markets could require an additional 260 million square feet of space if workplace density shifts to 100 square feet per employee, according to Cushman and Wakefield. Current inventory across these markets is 1,012 million square feet, with an average density of 80 square feet.

stories.title: Top 10 developers launch homes worth Rs 59,336 crore
stories.summary: Godrej Properties led new home launches between January and September with a potential sales value of Rs 10,362 crore, according to CRE Matrix. Prestige Group and Sobha Ltd followed. The top five developers accounted for 65.8 percent of the total potential sales value recorded by the top ten.

stories.title: Average time to sell housing stock rises across eight cities
stories.summary: The average time to sell existing housing inventory across India’s eight leading residential markets rose to 6.1 quarters by the end of September, up from 5.8 quarters a year ago. The current inventory overhang remains lower than the levels recorded between 2018 and 2021.

stories.title: Delhi-NCR and Ahmedabad housing inventory takes two years to clear
stories.summary: The time required to sell existing housing inventory in Delhi-NCR and Ahmedabad has reached approximately two years. Knight Frank India attributed the situation to moderating demand for luxury housing in Delhi-NCR and new residential launches outpacing sales in Ahmedabad. The market is currently navigating a demand-supply imbalance.

HouseEazy expands into Pune market
stories.summary: Proptech platform HouseEazy recorded over 600 crore in transactions during its first month in Pune. The Accel-backed company previously operated in Noida, Ghaziabad and Gurugram. It has now expanded its primary mandate business to include secondary resale transactions in its new market.

stories.title: NCR home sales drop to five-year low
stories.summary: Housing sales in the National Capital Region have fallen to their lowest quarterly level in five years. Despite years of rising prices and consistent demand for luxury apartments, the market appears to be at a turning point as affluent buyers turn cautious.

stories.title: Avg housing prices along Yamuna Expressway in NCR jump 2.5 times in 4 yrs
stories.summary: According to a report by Square Yards, the housing prices along Yamuna Expressway have increased at 27 per cent CAGR (compounded annual growth rate) between 2022 and 2026 Listen to This Article Average housing prices along the Yamuna Expressway in Delhi-NCR have jumped 2.5 times in the last four years

stories.title: Yamuna Expressway housing prices rise 2.5 times
stories.summary: Average housing prices along the Yamuna Expressway reached Rs 9,500 per square foot in 2026, up from Rs 3,700 per square foot in 2022. Square Yards reported a 27 percent compound annual growth rate, citing improved infrastructure and consumer demand as the primary drivers for the price increase.

stories.title: Gurgaon builder ordered to refund homebuyer
stories.summary: The District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission in Gurgaon ordered Czar Buildwell to refund Rs 1.35 lakh to a buyer who withdrew from an affordable housing project. The developer must pay 9 percent annual interest plus Rs 52,000 in compensation for mental harassment and litigation expenses.

stories.title: Flexible offices see record leasing as firms avoid long-term commitments
stories.summary: Companies are increasingly opting for flexible workspaces to scale operations without being locked into long-term leases. Despite record demand in India's office market, businesses are prioritising operational freedom over the security of traditional contracts. Gross office leasing across India's top seven markets reached 61.06 million sq ft this year.

stories.title: Global capability centres drive India office demand
stories.summary: Global capability centres are emerging as primary drivers of India's office market as multinational firms expand technology and research operations. Leasing by these centres rose 19 percent year-on-year to 6.8 million square feet in the third quarter of 2026, accounting for 36 percent of total quarterly transactions.

stories.title: Retail leasing in India hits four-year high
stories.summary: Retail leasing in India's top seven cities reached 6.27 million sq ft in the first half of 2026, a 10.5 percent increase year-on-year. Malls are seeing rising footfalls and retailer demand, though developers face the ongoing challenge of maintaining occupancy through curated store mixes and consumer experiences.

stories.title: Phoenix Malls launches Disney and Marvel festive activations
stories.summary: Phoenix Malls is introducing Disney and Marvel-themed interactive spaces across five retail locations in Bengaluru, Chennai and Pune starting November 27. The activations include a 70 ft Marvel installation at the Phoenix Mall of Asia, as the company attempts to draw festive crowds through character-based experiences.

stories.title: Apple to open seventh India store in Hyderabad
stories.summary: Apple will open its first retail store in Hyderabad on December 10, marking its seventh location in India. The expansion follows the company's reported sales exceeding $10 billion in the country, driven by flexible installment plans and growing demand among affluent consumers for its hardware products.

stories.title: Tossin Pizza expands to DLF Atrium Place
stories.summary: Tossin Pizza has opened a 44-seater restaurant at DLF Atrium Place in Gurugram, bringing the chain's network to 28 outlets. The new location aims to serve professionals in the business district and residents in the surrounding area, continuing the brand's focus on commercial and corporate dining hubs.

Noho office leasing reaches nine-year high
stories.summary: Office demand in the Noho submarket has reached its strongest level since 2017, with nearly 900,000 sq ft leased in the 12 months through September 2026. The recovery follows a period of corporate consolidation and the departure of Meta, which left 250,000 sq ft of space vacant.

stories.title: Data centre funding in India surges 11-fold
stories.summary: Disclosed funding for India's data centre infrastructure reached 16,458.52 crore in 2026, an 11-fold increase over the previous year. Four operators accounted for 99.9 percent of the total inflows, while equity and private equity deals replaced debt as the primary source of capital for the sector.

Karnataka evaluates coastal site for sustainable data centre
stories.summary: The Karnataka government is assessing a 49-acre site near Tannirbhavi beach in Mangaluru for a potential sustainable data centre. Minister Priyank Kharge is reviewing the land's suitability under Coastal Regulation Zone rules, with plans to issue a white paper on infrastructure requirements and permitted activities at the location.

stories.title: Prologis sells Pennsylvania warehouse for data centre conversion
stories.summary: Prologis has sold a 1 million sq ft industrial facility in Pennsylvania to Fluidstack for $162.9 million. Originally constructed as a warehouse in 2023, the site was approved for data centre conversion earlier this year, featuring plans for a closed-loop cooling system and dedicated power capacity.

stories.title: Prologis balances warehouse portfolio with data centre sales
stories.summary: Prologis has sold a data-centre-ready industrial site in Pennsylvania while acquiring a logistics property in Southern California. The company, which describes itself as the world's largest industrial real estate firm, is using the demand for data centre infrastructure to recycle capital and expand its core warehouse holdings.

stories.title: Bombay Coated & Special Steels acquires industrial land in Maharashtra
stories.summary: Bombay Coated & Special Steels has taken possession of an 8.48-acre industrial plot at Supa Parner Industrial Park. The land was transferred by the Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation on November 19, 2026, providing the steel processing company with space for future infrastructure development and manufacturing expansion.

stories.title: Gujarat signs MoU for 250 MW green data centre
stories.summary: The Gujarat government and Larsen and Toubro VYOMA have signed a memorandum of understanding for a 250 MW green data centre at Dholera Special Investment Region. The project involves a 25,000 crore investment and is expected to be operational by 2028, aiming to support AI and digital infrastructure.

stories.title: Coweta County voters to decide on $17 billion data centre project
stories.summary: Voters in Coweta County will decide on January 12 whether to repeal the approval of a proposed $17 billion data centre campus. The ballot measure, triggered by a resident petition, would also prohibit future data centre and cryptocurrency mining operations across the county.

stories.title: Centre approves 50,000 crore in urban infrastructure projects
stories.summary: The central government has approved urban infrastructure projects worth more than 50,000 crore across 16 states and union territories. The funding covers city redevelopment, water management and waste processing, with the Urban Challenge Fund encouraging cities to adopt market-based financing rather than relying solely on government grants.

stories.title: YEIDA revenue quadruples amid infrastructure push
stories.summary: The Yamuna Expressway Industrial Development Authority reported receipts of 7,071.48 crore up to October 30, nearly four times the 1,746.38 crore collected during the same period last year. The authority spent 4,857.49 crore on land acquisition, which accounted for the largest share of its annual expenditure.

stories.title: YEIDA income reaches 7,071 crore
stories.summary: The Yamuna Expressway Industrial Development Authority reported income of 7,071.48 crore for the current financial year up to October 30, compared to 1,746.38 crore in the previous year. The board approved new measures for industrial land, business parks, road repairs and waste regulation at its 94th meeting.

stories.title: Karnataka approves housing and land-access scheme
stories.summary: Karnataka’s Cabinet has approved a programme to place 1.5 million residential sites in the state pipeline, with 500,000 sites planned for the first phase. The package includes 100,000 newly sanctioned houses, construction assistance and a waiver of stamp duty and registration charges through the Kaveri 2.0 digital platform.

stories.title: Kolkata ring road project approved at 14,000 crore
stories.summary: Union Minister Nitin Gadkari has approved a 250-km ring road project in Kolkata to address traffic congestion. The project is estimated to cost 14,000 crore. The decision follows requests from state officials regarding the city's traffic woes. The minister also inaugurated 22 other development projects in the region.

stories.title: Meerut inner ring road project moves to valuation
stories.summary: A 5.7-km stretch of the Meerut Inner Ring Road, estimated to cost 457 crore, is moving forward as authorities begin land valuation in five villages. The project aims to connect Hapur Road with the Meerut-Roorkee Highway to reduce traffic pressure on the existing Bijli Bamba Bypass.

stories.title: Yashobhoomi-Gurugram Metro link remains at proposal stage
stories.summary: A proposed Metro corridor between Yashobhoomi and Rajiv Chowk is currently under consideration as part of the Delhi Metro Phase V(B) expansion. The project has not yet received formal approvals, alignment details or a construction timeline. It remains one of eight routes submitted to the government for review.

stories.title: Nashik to Chennai Expressway faces land acquisition delays
stories.summary: The bid-opening date for a major Maharashtra stretch of the 1,271-km Nashik to Chennai Expressway has been extended to December 11, 2026. Land acquisition in the Nashik and Ahilyanagar districts has taken longer than expected for the planned six-lane, greenfield, access-controlled highway project.

stories.title: Bengaluru Metro awaits safety nod for Pink Line trials
stories.summary: The Bengaluru Metro Rail Corporation has requested federal approval to begin trial runs on the underground section of the Pink Line. While station finishing and signalling work continues, a buffer barrier remains in place to prevent trains from entering the tunnel before safety clearance is granted.

stories.title: Developer fined for unauthorised project branding
stories.summary: The Himachal Pradesh Real Estate Regulatory Authority has fined Aegis Centre Point Developers 10 lakh for advertising its Mashobra project as The Ridge-Mashobra without regulatory approval. The developer was ordered to pay the penalty within one month and immediately cease using the unauthorised project name.

stories.title: Enforcement Directorate attaches 545 crore in Vatika Group case
stories.summary: The Enforcement Directorate has attached assets worth over 545 crore, including a South Delhi farmhouse, belonging to promoters of the Gurugram-based Vatika Group. The action follows a money laundering investigation linked to alleged fraud involving homebuyers. The group has not commented on the attachment.

stories.title: CREDAI-MCHI hosts construction pollution workshop
stories.summary: CREDAI-MCHI, in collaboration with the Maharashtra Department of Environment and Climate Change and WRI India, held a capacity-building workshop on air pollution mitigation. The event focused on encouraging construction firms in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region to adopt pollution-control measures at their active work sites.

stories.title: CREDAI-MCHI promotes cleaner construction in Mumbai
stories.summary: CREDAI-MCHI recently organised a workshop in Mumbai to promote air pollution mitigation practices at construction sites. The initiative, supported by the state government and WRI India, aimed to increase awareness among developers and industry stakeholders regarding effective pollution control measures across the Mumbai Metropolitan Region.

stories.title: Gurugram residents report unauthorised commercial activity
stories.summary: Residents have complained to the Gurugram Metropolitan Development Authority regarding the alleged unauthorised storage and sale of building materials in Sector 42. The complaint claims commercial activities have resumed at the site despite previous enforcement actions and the demolition of structures by local authorities.

stories.title: Urban infrastructure funding gap persists
stories.summary: Urban Local Bodies are struggling to fund infrastructure as India's urban population is expected to reach 40 percent by 2030. Property taxes and regulatory fees have proven insufficient to cover development costs, while land acquisition remains a significant hurdle for municipal authorities seeking to expand city services.

stories.title: Supreme Court orders prosecution in subvention fraud case
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has directed four major lenders to grant unconditional sanction for the prosecution of officials involved in an alleged builder-financier nexus. The case concerns home loan subvention schemes that have left numerous homebuyers in financial distress. The court set a one-week deadline for the sanction.

stories.title: Government confirms construction product reforms
stories.summary: The government plans to introduce legislation next year to implement post-Grenfell reforms for construction products. The measures will include stricter oversight of material selection and installation starting in 2027. The industry will be granted a transitional period of at least 12 months to comply with the new rules.

stories.title: Construction product reforms set for 2027
stories.summary: The government will introduce legislation next year to strengthen building safety and oversight of construction materials. The reforms, which follow a white paper consultation, will mandate stricter standards for how products are selected and used. The industry will receive a transitional period of at least 12 months.

stories.title: Motilal Oswal launches five sector-specific ETFs
stories.summary: Motilal Oswal Mutual Fund has launched five new exchange-traded funds on the NSE, allowing investors to target specific sectors including private banks, public sector banks, real estate, growth stocks and government securities. The funds provide an alternative to broad-market indices for investors seeking specific market exposure.

stories.title: Nifty Realty index hits 52-week high
stories.summary: The Nifty Realty index reached a new 52-week high of 972.30 on Thursday, rising 3 percent in intraday trading. The gains were led by a 5 percent surge in shares of Prestige Estates Projects and Brigade Enterprises. The index outperformed the broader Nifty 50, which declined 0.14 percent.

stories.title: Nifty Realty hits fresh 52-week high, index up 22% in a month, Prestige Estate, Brigade Enterprises lead... - Moneycontr
Nifty Realty index rises 22 percent in one month
stories.summary: The Nifty Realty index hit a fresh 52-week high of 966.45 on Thursday, marking a 22 percent gain over the last month. Investors responded to new insolvency rule amendments for the real estate sector. The index rose 2.59 percent while the Nifty 50 gained 0.42 percent.

stories.title: Commercial real estate eyes retrofitting opportunity
stories.summary: India's commercial real estate market could hold a 3.8 lakh crore rupee opportunity in retrofitting 300 million square feet of aging office space. Knight Frank India suggests the process requires an investment of 500 to 3,000 rupees per square foot, potentially increasing rental yields by 50 to 100 percent.

stories.title: Ashiana Housing joint venture acquires Chennai land
stories.summary: Kairav Developers, a joint venture involving Ashiana Housing, has acquired 9.57 acres near Chennai's East Coast Road. The company plans to develop a premium senior living community on the site, projecting 1,100 crore rupees in sales potential from nearly one million square feet of saleable space.

stories.title: Ashiana Housing joint venture expands in Chennai
stories.summary: Ashiana Housing's joint venture, Kairav Developers, has purchased 9.57 acres of land near Chennai for a senior living project. The development is expected to provide 9 lakh square feet of saleable area and 1,100 crore rupees in sales potential. The company previously completed a larger transaction in 2025.

stories.title: Arihant Foundations joint venture buys Chennai land
stories.summary: Arihant Foundations and Housing disclosed that its joint venture, Kairav Developers, has acquired 9.57 acres near Chennai. The entity plans to build a senior living project with an estimated sales potential of 1,100 crore rupees, targeting 9 lakh square feet of saleable area.

stories.title: Ashiana and Arihant joint venture acquires Chennai land
stories.summary: Ashiana Housing and Arihant Foundations and Housing have completed an outright purchase of 9.57 acres in Chengalpattu district through their joint venture, Kairav Developers. The land is designated for a senior living project with an estimated sales potential of 1,100 crore rupees.

stories.title: Shoper Buildtech launches commercial project in Ghaziabad
stories.summary: Shoper Buildtech has launched LUMERA High Street in Siddharth Vihar, Ghaziabad, in partnership with 360 PropGuide. The commercial project aims to serve 50,000 families by combining retail, dining, and studio suites. The developer is banking on the area's proximity to Delhi-NCR employment corridors and major expressways.

stories.summary: A report from Maven Insights suggests real estate tokenization is gaining traction across the Gulf Cooperation Council. The firm claims the practice creates new possibilities for how property assets are financed, owned, and traded. It aims to broaden investment participation and rethink traditional business models for property owners.

stories.title: Prosus reports 37 percent profit growth in real estate
stories.summary: Prosus reported that its OLX real estate arm saw adjusted EBITDA rise 37 percent to 56 million dollars in the first half of the 2027 financial year. The division achieved a 52 percent margin as the company shifted agencies toward portfolio-based pricing models.

stories.title: HomeRepairly launches nationwide matching service
stories.summary: HomeRepairly has expanded its online platform to provide free matching services for homeowners across the United States. Users submit project descriptions and receive up to three quotes from independent local service providers. The company aims to connect homeowners with contractors without charging for the initial referral.

stories.title: Larisa Mathur expands real estate lending platform
stories.summary: Larisa Mathur, founder of Propertunity Capital, is managing a lending platform for real estate investors. Mathur brings 15 years of experience in real estate finance and operations to the firm, which aims to provide accessible financing solutions to investors through persistence and excellence.

stories.title: Kerakoll India marks two decades of operations
stories.summary: Kerakoll India is celebrating 20 years of providing sustainable building materials and construction solutions in the country. The subsidiary of the Italy-based Kerakoll Group entered the Indian market in 2006, focusing on bringing advanced building solutions to the local construction ecosystem.

stories.title: Construction material prices decline in November
stories.summary: Construction material prices dropped in November, with cement costs falling for the second consecutive month in Ghana. The decline follows broader trends in the local construction sector.

stories.title: Heidelberg Materials trials carbon-negative concrete
stories.summary: Heidelberg Materials UK is trialing a carbon-negative ready-mixed concrete containing ACLA, a biochar mineral matrix developed by Low Carbon Materials. The material was used as blinding concrete for a fish and eel pass on the River Thames. The product aims to reduce embodied carbon in construction projects.

stories.title: Heidelberg Materials supplies in-situ carbon negative concrete containing ACLA for the first time in the UK
stories.summary: Heidelberg Materials UK has worked collaboratively with BAM UK & Ireland and the Environment Agency to deliver the UK’s first carbon-negative in-situ ready-mixed concrete containing ACLA. - The material was used as blinding concrete during construction of a multi species fish and eel pass at Bell Weir on the River

stories.title: Report warns of vague sustainability claims in construction
stories.summary: A new report from the Anti-Greenwash Charter and the Alliance for Sustainable Building Products warns that the market does not consistently reward manufacturers for providing credible environmental evidence. The findings follow a government white paper on construction product reform, highlighting a gap between policy and market practice.

stories.title: Philippines prioritizes local construction materials
stories.summary: Government agencies have signed a joint administrative order requiring public bodies to prioritize Philippine-manufactured construction materials for infrastructure projects. The Department of Trade and Industry and other agencies aim to strengthen support for local manufacturers of steel, cement, and related products through new procurement rules.

stories.summary: Stanbic Bank Kenya has secured EDGE Advanced and Net Zero Carbon certifications for its Nairobi headquarters. The bank achieved the ratings through a strategic refurbishment of its existing premises rather than new construction. The project demonstrates that older infrastructure can be retrofitted to meet modern environmental standards.

stories.summary: Driven by commitment to creating long-term sustainable value, Stanbic Bank Kenya has transformed its headquarters, Stanbic Bank Centre on Chiromo Road in Westlands into a modern, environmentally responsible and future-ready workplace. This milestone is further distinguished by the attainment of internationally recognised EDGE Advanced certification from Green Business Certification Inc.

stories.title: ACE Powerhouse wins second consecutive green building award
stories.summary: ACE Powerhouse at Campus Skellefteå has been named MB Plus Project of the Year at the 2026 Sweden Green Building Awards. This follows the project winning Environmental Building of the Year in 2025. The project is cited as proof of long-term sustainability efforts and collaborative design.

stories.title: IGBC and University of Mumbai partner on green education
stories.summary: The Indian Green Building Council and the University of Mumbai have signed a memorandum of understanding to develop a specialized course on the green built environment. The partnership aims to integrate industry-oriented learning into engineering and architecture curricula to build a skilled talent pool for the sector.

Invesco closes Asia-Pacific property fund at $1.35 billion
stories.summary: Invesco Real Estate has reached a final close of $1.35 billion for its fifth Asia-Pacific property fund, including co-investment sidecars. The manager has already deployed one-third of the capital into student housing and senior living. Half of the fund's limited partners are repeat investors from previous series.

stories.title: Invesco Real Estate raises $1.4bn for Asia-Pacific value strategy
stories.summary: Invesco Real Estate has raised $1.35bn (€1.23bn) at the final close of its latest Asia-Pacific value-add fund, including sidecar commitments. stories.title: US new home sales rise as Chicago sales hit 15-year low
stories.summary: Nationwide purchases of newly built homes rose 14.2 percent to an annualized rate of 701,000 in October, exceeding all economist estimates. Meanwhile, Chicago recorded its weakest October sales in 15 years. Builders are finding that price reductions and mortgage incentives work better in some places than others.

stories.title: US new home sales rise as Chicago market hits 15-year low
stories.summary: Sales of newly built single-family homes in the United States increased 14.2 percent in October to an annualized rate of 701,000. While the national figures beat all economist estimates, Chicago saw its lowest October sales volume in 15 years. Incentives appear to be a regional preference.

stories.title: Bank of Korea raises base rate to 3.25 percent
stories.summary: The Bank of Korea raised its base rate by 0.25 percentage points to 3.25 percent, the highest level since 2008. Seoul apartment sales have fallen by nearly half over the last six months as buyers retreat. The rental market is currently absorbing the displaced demand.

stories.title: Global funds pour money into Japan real estate
stories.summary: Commercial real estate investment in Japan reached a quarterly record of 2.21 trillion yen, or 13.9 billion dollars, in the third quarter. Investors are betting that corporate reforms and economic recovery will drive rental growth. The market is currently enjoying the return of inflation.

stories.title: Japan property draws global money, but easy gains fade as rates rise - Reuters
Three Iberian cities rank among top European property destinations
stories.summary: Colliers reports that Madrid, Lisbon, and Barcelona are among the ten most sought-after cities for international property investors in 2027. The ranking covers the EMEA region and places Milan at the top. Investors continue to find the Iberian Peninsula a compelling place to park capital.
